Thanks Aditya — great notes and thanks for moving quickly. A few clarifications from our side:

- ClearSight handles sensitive patient billing data. Anything that could be tied back to a patient (name, DOB, MRN, invoice numbers, or full addresses) is considered PHI for this engagement.
- Our preference is to avoid retention of request/response text in any analytics or logs — effectively 0 retention for tokenized logs. We understand there are implementation nuances; if 0-retention is impossible we would consider a very short window (<=7 days) with firm deletion and attestations.
- We need to see Redwood's most recent SOC 2 report and a description of keys/where logs are stored. Procurement will require a short MOA for the pilot; legal expects to review any retention carveouts.

I'll have procurement loop in after you send options.

Aditya / team — technical summary and options we can propose to ClearSight:

Option A — Hosted, strict short-retention
- Configure request/response logging to "no-persist" mode for this account: that prevents writing full transcript logs to long-term analytics stores.
- We still maintain ephemeral KV cache for active sessions (needed for decoding and reduced token cost). That cache is in-memory and rotated; not written to disk by default.
- Provide 7-day retention window for token-level debug traces + automated deletion job. We can produce deletion attestations and an audit log of deletion events.
- Encryption at rest (AES-256) + customer can opt out of platform analytics.
- Pros: fastest time-to-value; cons: we cannot guarantee absolute 0-retention for transient operational traces in hosted mode.

Option B — Redwood Dedicated / Private deployment
- Dedicated pools with customer-managed KMS and configuration to disable all logging pipelines — supports effectively 0 retention for request/response artifacts.
- Requires procurement lead time (2–6 weeks) and network setup; better for regulated PHI workloads.
- We can include stronger SLAs and on-prem audit capabilities.

Recommended commercial packaging for pilot:
- 90-day pilot on Hosted with 7-day short-retention + deletion attestations while customer evaluates Dedicated. If they need 0 retention we move to Private deployment.
- Deliverables: SOC 2 report, data handling playbook, deletion attestations.

Attachments I will share for the customer: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (attestation), and a short tech note on "no-persist" toggles.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Proposal: 90-day pilot — short-retention option (7 days)

Hi Bethany — following up with a concrete pilot offer based on our internal review and Laura's options. High level:

- Pilot length: 90 days.
- Mode: Hosted with "no-persist" logging for your tenant + token-level debug traces retained for 7 days then deleted.
- Controls: encryption at rest, ability to opt out of platform analytics, deletion attestations delivered upon request.
- If ClearSight requires an absolute zero retention for production, we will migrate you to Redwood Private (dedicated) with customer-managed KMS as the next step.
- Commercials: pilot credits to cover initial usage; we'll share a short MOA for signatures.

I've attached an initial draft (7-day-offer-v1.docx) and requested legal to prepare MOA language that captures the retention exception for the pilot. If that looks reasonable we'll get procurement looped in and sign the MOA.

Thanks — Vivek
